role: FIRST sole independent scientific, full Chinese, full English and original-question text reviewer
summary: No substantive science, Chinese, English, source-preservation or original-task defects found in the four frozen text templates. All 22 ordered source blocks and all four questions were reviewed in both languages against a saved independent source-first baseline. No repairs requested or performed.

independence.reviewMethod: Manual full-text comparison against the independently saved source baseline, supported by read-only structured equality and SHA-256/byte checks. Author rationale read only after baseline creation; its notes do not establish these verdicts.

coverage.countClarification: The raw lesson.prose array contains 22 blocks, not 21. Its two figure placeholders and two captions are included in that count; there are 18 narrative blocks. Paragraph splitting inside translated block text does not change source-block identity.

preservationEvidence.figureLabelTranslationOnly: English uses Figure in place of 图 while preserving numbers, identities, anchors and source provenance. This is not figure approval.

metadataTextFindings.finding: Lesson titles retain the period and circuit-equation subject; English chapter and section translate their source meanings. Lesson ID, number 20, page boundaries, exercise count and figure IDs/pages are retained. Original metadata remains exact in embedded source.data. Section-break text anchors refer to the inspected prose; this is not a native layout or rendering test.

perBlock.enFinding: Complete equivalent model statement, including fixed positive parameters and the final-paragraph exception.

perBlock.scienceFinding: Spring frequency, 1/C-to-k and L-to-m correspondence, and angular frequency sqrt(1/LC) are complete. Mathematical equivalence is scoped to ideal linear undamped models; derivation still follows.
perBlock.zhFinding: Distinguishes angular frequency from the general period/frequency goal and retains the named formula and all correspondences.
perBlock.enFinding: Natural equivalent wording with spring constant, inductance and mass correctly assigned. Thomson naming remains linked to the source attribution in block 4.

perBlock.scienceFinding: Full T=2pi/omega_0=2pi sqrt(LC) expression and (2.4) preserved for the ideal circuit.
perBlock.zhFinding: Concise and complete statement of the ideal free-oscillation period.
perBlock.enFinding: Complete equivalent statement; period is not confused with frequency.

perBlock.scienceFinding: The historical naming, British nationality and priority claim are explicitly attributed to the textbook, not asserted as fresh historical certification or arbitrarily relabeled.
perBlock.zhFinding: 原书 clearly governs both the name and attribution.
perBlock.enFinding: The source and whom it credits clearly attribute the historical claim; Thomson is a faithful rendering of 汤姆生, not a newly substituted entity.

perBlock.scienceFinding: Keeps the need for a governing-equation derivation beyond heuristic analogy, and limits shared quantitative laws to the respective ideal models.
perBlock.zhFinding: Preserves the distinction between analogy and strict derivation without claiming universal equivalence of all mechanical and electrical systems.
perBlock.enFinding: Complete logical sequence and appropriately qualified rigorous-derivation wording.

perBlock.scienceFinding: Introduces the conservation derivation under negligible R and fixed L,C. Textual reference to figure 30 is retained.
perBlock.zhFinding: Complete heading and conditions, with both source-page references retained.
perBlock.enFinding: Equivalent complete heading and conservation statement; figure number unchanged.

perBlock.scienceFinding: Magnetic Li^2/2 and electric q^2/(2C) terms correctly sum to total E; signs, powers, factors and (2.5) are unchanged.
perBlock.zhFinding: Correctly assigns field energies to coil and capacitor.
perBlock.enFinding: Same complete energy decomposition and formula.

perBlock.scienceFinding: Empty fig-30 text anchor, order, page and source reference retained. This finding concerns the text carrier only.
perBlock.zhFinding: 图 30 anchor unchanged.
perBlock.enFinding: Figure 30 label translation preserves identity and number.

perBlock.scienceFinding: R=0 gives constant total energy in the stated loss-free model without external energy input.
perBlock.zhFinding: Correctly retains time independence of total energy and the ideal conditions.
perBlock.enFinding: Equivalent condition and conclusion; does not imply R=0 alone removes every possible loss in real systems.

perBlock.scienceFinding: Figure-30 caption and provenance retained; no visual claim made.
perBlock.zhFinding: Original caption text retained.
perBlock.enFinding: Figure 30 is a complete equivalent caption.

perBlock.scienceFinding: Constant-energy differentiation and both equivalent rate equations retained, including the negative sign in (2.6).
perBlock.zhFinding: Clear separation of the sum-zero relation and its equivalent opposite-rate form.
perBlock.enFinding: Same two complete equations and equivalence; no lost derivative or sign.

perBlock.zhFinding: Explicit exchange language preserves the rate and conservation meanings.
perBlock.enFinding: Equal in magnitude and opposite in sign faithfully expresses the source statement.

perBlock.enFinding: Evaluating the time derivatives using the chain rule is technically precise and equivalent.

perBlock.scienceFinding: Defines signed charge on a selected plate and positive current into it, making q'=i consistent. The resulting Li'i=-qi/C retains the sign and (2.8).
perBlock.zhFinding: Explicit signed convention prevents interpreting current intensity as always positive.

Neither version authorizes all-time division by zero or uses energy conservation to certify an arbitrary stationary charged trajectory.

perBlock.enFinding: Nonzero intervals, smooth ideal LC oscillation and must not be performed at those instants preserve the exact limits.

perBlock.scienceFinding: All four substitutions q/x, q''/x'', 1/C/k and L/m plus the prior-equation references are retained. Spring correspondence is exact within linear undamped models; the simple pendulum is explicitly small-angle only.

perBlock.enFinding: Full equivalent substitutions and correct small-angle exception; model exactness is neither weakened nor overextended.

perBlock.scienceFinding: Both squared-frequency coefficients, derivation of (2.3)/(2.4), growth of T with either L or C at fixed other parameter, and the current/charge-transfer explanations are preserved. perBlock.scienceFinding: Losses cause damping. Period growth with R is confined to fixed L,C in the underdamped oscillatory RLC response. For an initially charged capacitor and zero coil current, sufficiently large R suppresses reverse-polarity oscillatory recharge while charge still discharges toward zero; neither version says there is no discharge.
perBlock.zhFinding: Explicitly excludes nonoscillatory states from the period claim and retains continuing discharge and no polarity reversal.
perBlock.enFinding: Equivalent underdamped limit and initial-state qualification, with still discharges and approaches zero clearly stated.
